0.text: First Officer, it's Chiara. Just checking you still exist. The crew asked, I said I'd find out.

antworten.text: “I exist. Tell them thank you for asking.”

0.text: Quick one. Lunch is at one, and I'm not keeping a plate warm for anybody. I'm keeping a plate warm for you. Once.

antworten.text: “Rate the plate before I get there. Out of ten.”

0.text: You left your cabin window open. I closed it. That's all. That's the whole call.

antworten.text: “Thanks. I'd have come back to a puddle.”

1.text: Sunset from the bridge just now, I'd say seven. You're missing a seven, First Officer. That's a big loss.

antworten.text: “Save me the next one. I'll take a six.”
“You never give anything above a seven.”

1.text: Lola burned the focaccia and blamed the oven, the oven is innocent, I checked. Are you eating out there? Actually eating?
I told Jana to polish the brass and she polished the bell. The bell is gleaming. Come back and say something nice to her, she'd die happy.

antworten.text: “I'll tell her it's the best bell on the coast.”

2.text: It's quiet here without you shouting about solar panels. I didn't think I'd say that. Don't make it weird.

antworten.text: “I miss the noise too. Nearly home.”

2.text: I'm on the bridge, nobody's here, and I just wanted to hear a voice that isn't the radio. Yours will do.

antworten.text: “Then I'll keep talking for a minute.”
“Mine will do? High praise from you.”

2.text: Come back in one piece, please. I've already sorted the first-aid kit twice today, and that's not a hobby.

antworten.text: “Sort it a third time, just in case.”

0.text: Officer, Rosi. Is the bat holding up? If the grip is slipping, don't fix it yourself. You'll make it worse.

antworten.text: “I wasn't going to touch it. Much.”

0.text: The generator is making a noise I don't like, and I wanted to tell somebody who wouldn't say just turn it off. So, you.
I'm not calling because I'm worried. I'm calling because the radio was boring. Totally different thing.

1.text: I named the new welder. It's called Phoenix. It rises from the sparks. Okay, it's a stupid name, but it's mine, and it's staying.
Officer! If anything out there bites your jacket, bring me the teeth marks. I want to see what I'm up against.
I fixed the coffee machine, which nobody asked for, and now everybody thinks I'm a saint. I'm not a saint. I was just bored without you breaking things.

antworten.text: “You are a bit of a saint.”
“I don't break things. I test them.”

2.text: Come back before dark, okay? Not because of me. Because of Phoenix, my new welder. Phoenix misses you. It's a welder thing.

antworten.text: “Tell Phoenix I'll be home before dark.”

2.text: I keep looking at the door of the workshop like you're going to walk in with something broken. It's a habit. A dumb one.
Whatever's out there, hit it with the heavy end first. And then come back and tell me everything. In order.

antworten.text: “Heavy end first. Then you get every detail.”

0.text: G'day Boss, Lola here! No reason. Just wanted to say there's soup if you want soup. Or not. No pressure. Mostly the cheese.
Don't tell anyone I told you, but Maxwell cried at a cooking video this morning. Anyway. How's the hike, mate?
Boss, quick question, do you eat coriander or are you one of those soap people? I'm planning, see.

1.text: I'm making you something for when you get back and I'm not telling you what it is. It's bao. I told you. I'm rubbish at secrets.

antworten.text: “That's the worst secret I've ever heard.”

1.text: Reckon you've walked about a hundred k by now, eh? Heaps of hills on that island. Drink some water, mate, I mean it.
The crew's having a who-misses-the-boss-most competition. Chiara's winning, but don't tell her I said that. Mostly the cheese.

antworten.text: “Tell them all I miss them too.”

2.text: It's just me in the galley and the kettle, and I thought, I'll ring the boss. So. Hi. That's it. Hi.

antworten.text: “That's the whole call? I love it.”

2.text: Come home hungry, alright? I've been cooking like you're bringing an army. Bring an appetite at least.

antworten.text: “I'll be starving. Save me the best bit.”
“I'll bring the goat. She eats anything.”

2.text: You know you're the only one who ever says thank you for the food? Like, properly. Just thought you should know that. Anyway. Be careful.

0.text: Darling, Sophia. The guests have asked where you've gone. I said off saving the world. Was I far off?
I'm calling about the dinner on Thursday. I need to know if you're alive for it. Seating charts are cruel to the dead.
Forgive the intrusion. I wrote something in my little book just now and it made me think of you. No, I won't say what.

1.text: Darling, the sea's flat and the guests are asleep, which is the closest this boat gets to peace. How's your mountain?
Ten euros says you come back with a scratch on your face and pretend it's nothing. Do I win?

antworten.text: “I'll walk into a tree just to make you rich.”

1.text: Lea asked me if mountains have tides. I said no. She looked so disappointed I almost said yes. You'd have handled it better.

2.text: No show tonight, darling. I just wanted to hear how you are. Really. Not the business-page version.

antworten.text: “Tired, a bit sore, glad you called.”

2.text: I find I'm counting the hours until you're back, which is undignified. Please don't tell anyone. Least of all me.

antworten.text: “Your secret's in my little book now.”

2.text: Be careful out there. I'm serious, for once. I've only just started being honest with you, and I'd like to keep going.

0.text: Hi! It's Lea. Sorry, is this okay? Did you know goats can climb almost vertical rock? I just read it. Thought you should know. For the mountain.

antworten.text: “I've got a goat with me. She agrees.”

0.text: Sophia said not to bother you, but I wanted to ask if you've seen any eagles. Proper big ones? No? Okay. Bye. Sorry.

antworten.text: “No eagles yet. I'll look for you.”

0.text: The water's so clear today you can see the anchor chain all the way down. I'm telling everyone. You're everyone now.

antworten.text: “Save me a swim when I'm back.”

1.text: Octopuses have three hearts, and mountains have zero, which is why you should come back to the sea soon. That's science.
I found a sea slug that looks exactly like a tiny dragon and nobody gets as excited as you would. Hurry up and be excited.

antworten.text: “A tiny dragon? Keep it safe for me.”

1.text: Are you being careful, proper careful? Not Chiara careful, where she just shouts at things. Actually careful.

antworten.text: “I might shout at a few things.”

2.text: I'm on the swim platform with my feet in the water and I thought, he'd like this. So I called. That's allowed, isn't it?

antworten.text: “It's more than allowed. I'm glad you did.”
“Only if you describe the water in detail.”

2.text: Can I tell you something silly? I waved at the mountain this morning. In case you were looking. Were you looking?
Come back dreckly, that's Cornish for sometime soon, but not too dreckly. You know what I mean. Okay. I'll stop talking now. I'm not stopping. Sorry.

0.text: Frankfurt. Holm. The doctors let me use the phone. I wanted to know if my ship is still floating.

antworten.text: “Floating, and in good hands. Get well.”

0.text: They say I must rest. I don't rest. So I'm calling you instead. How is the crew?

antworten.text: “Better than the doctors, by the sound of it.”

0.text: I heard you went up into the hills. Take more water than you think you need. Mountains don't care about papers.

antworten.text: “Water, and respect for the mountain. Takk.”
“Papers don't float, and they don't climb either.”

1.text: Frankfurt. The food here is terrible. I've decided it's a test. I'm passing. How are you passing yours?

antworten.text: “Lola could break you out with a sandwich.”

1.text: Chiara called me. She sounded calm. That means you're doing something right. Don't let it go to your head.
The nurse asked who I keep calling. I said a consultant who thinks he's a sailor. She laughed. You should be proud.

antworten.text: “Tell her I'm a sailor who thinks he's a consultant.”

2.text: I'm not good at this, Frankfurt. So I'll say it once. Be careful. The ship needs you more than it knows.

antworten.text: “Once is all I need from you.”

2.text: I looked at my father's compass today and thought of you. Don't ask me why. I won't explain it twice.

antworten.text: “I won't ask. Thank you for telling me.”

2.text: When I'm back on my feet, I'll teach you a proper bowline. You've earned the lesson. Barely.

antworten.text: “I'll be waiting for it. Rest first.”
“Barely is my favourite word from you.”

0.text: Comandante! Totò. I bet two to one you are lost already. Tell me I win.

antworten.text: “Two to one? I'm insulted. Make it five.”

0.text: Comandante, small question. If you find something nice up there, something nobody needs, you call Totò first. Okay? Just saying.
Madonna, it's hot. Even the fish are complaining. How are you up there, walking like a tourist?

1.text: Comandante! The crew bet on what time you come back. I took six o'clock. Please, for my wallet, six o'clock.

antworten.text: “I'll come at five past, just to ruin you.”

1.text: I sold a very small box to a very big man today. Don't worry. The box was legal. Mostly. How is the mountain?

antworten.text: “The mountain is fine. Be careful with the boxes.”

1.text: Piccola Jana asked if you have a phone up there. I said Comandante always has a phone. Do you? Yes. You do. I'm talking to you.

2.text: Comandante, no bet today. I just want to know you are okay. Strange, eh? Totò with no bet.

antworten.text: “No bet? Now I'm worried about you.”

2.text: When you come back, I cook. Real ragù, my nonna's, five hours. Nobody gets it. You get it. Don't tell Lola.

antworten.text: “Five hours of ragù. I'll be there.”

2.text: Be careful with the animals, Comandante. They are not bad, they are scared. I know scared. You go slow with them.

antworten.text: “Since when are you the wise one?”

0.text: Number One! Mr. Maximum checking in. Are you stretching before your hike? Mr. Maximum hopes yes. Mr. Maximum fears no.
Howzit, Number One. Jana did twenty push-ups today. Twenty! Mr. Maximum needed to tell someone, and you are someone.
Eish, brother, Mr. Maximum just remembered he never asked if you have snacks. Do you have snacks? Protein is a friend.

antworten.text: “Does a goat count as a snack?”

1.text: Number One! Mr. Maximum has designed a mountain workout in your honour. It's just climbing. You're already doing it. You're welcome.
Lekker news, brother. The crew trained together this morning, everybody, even Sophia. She did one squat. Very elegant squat.
Ja-nee, Number One, Mr. Maximum isn't worried. Mr. Maximum is just calling a lot. Different thing. Very different.

2.text: Brother, it's just me. No Mr. Maximum today. I wanted to say you're doing good. My gogo, my grandmother, would like you.

antworten.text: “That means a lot. Thank you, Maxwell.”

2.text: Number One, when you come back, we celebrate. Mr. Maximum will cook. Lola has said no. We'll celebrate anyway.

antworten.text: “Mr. Maximum cooking? I'll bring a fire extinguisher.”

2.text: Listen, brother. If something out there hurts, you breathe, you count to four, you keep going. Mr. Maximum believes in you. So does Maxwell.

antworten.text: “Both of you? That's a lot of belief.”

0.text: Hello? Sir? It's Jana. Sorry. Chiara said to call and ask if you need anything, so. Do you need anything? Sorry.

antworten.text: “I'm fine, Jana. Thank you for calling.”
“I need you to stop saying sorry.”

0.text: Servus, Sir. Sorry, wrong button first, I called the galley. Lola says hello. Also, hello.

antworten.text: “Two calls for the price of one.”

0.text: Sir, I learned a new knot today. Totò says it's for boats, but I think it's for everything. I just wanted to tell somebody.

1.text: Na geh, Sir, there's a cat on the boat. I mean, there's no cat. There's a very small potato. It says hello.

antworten.text: “Say hello to the potato for me.”
“The potato and I need to talk.”

1.text: Sir, I polished the bell, and Chiara said good, and then she said very good. Twice! I'm a bit happy. Sorry.
Coach made me run up the stairs ten times. Jessas, Sir, I think the mountain might be easier. How is the mountain?

antworten.text: “Swap with me? I'll do the stairs.”

2.text: Sir, can I say something? It's quieter when you're not here. Not bad quiet. Just. I'll stop. Sorry. No, I'm not sorry.

antworten.text: “Don't be sorry. I'll be back soon.”

2.text: I told Lea you'd be back before the stars come out. Please make me right, Sir. I'm never right.

antworten.text: “I'll make you right. Before the stars.”

2.text: Sir, you were always kind to me, even when I said sorry to the door. So I wanted to say. Be careful. Bitte.
